mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.1% over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate and the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) signal a successful monetary policy easing that reduces real interest rates and inflation uncertainty, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL decline by at least 0.1% over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%), a rise in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust economic expansion that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 2.5% and RSAFS rises by at least 0.5% over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0, it signals strong manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based economic expansion that boosts corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 0.5% over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500.0 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1500.0.
